territorial_scope.description: Free zones are areas of the national territory, determined by the Executive, with activities restricted to the zone and certain rules for goods and services crossing into the rest of the national territory.

evidence.quote: Las zonas francas son áreas del territorio nacional de propiedad pública o privada

summary.short: Uruguayan Free Zones Act (Ley 15.921, promulgated 17/12/1987): permits state or authorized private free zones in which users may carry out industrial, commercial and service activities with national tax exemptions, subject to executive contract authorization, Uruguayan staffing minimums and sanctions.
summary.long: Ley 15.921 (Free Zones Act), promulgated 17/12/1987 and published 26/01/1988, appears in a consolidated text that records later amendments (Leyes 19.566 of 2017, 19.996 of 2021, 20.212 of 2023 and 20.446 of 2025). It declares free zones of national interest and defines them as areas of national territory, delimited and isolated, that the Executive determines, where industrial, commercial and service activities may be carried out. Zones may be operated by the State or by authorized private operators. User contracts require prior authorization by the Área Zonas Francas of the Dirección General de Comercio and have maximum terms of 15 years (industrial), 10 years (commercial or service) and 5 years (indirect users), without automatic extensions. Users are exempt from national taxes for activities in the zone, and goods entering the zone are exempt from import taxes. Retail sales within the zone are prohibited, and sales to the rest of the national territory are restricted. Users must employ at least 75% Uruguayan personnel (50% for services). Violations may be sanctioned by fines of up to 10,000,000 UI, prohibition of operations, or loss of benefits, and authorizations may be revoked.

notes: Consolidated text ('Documento Actualizado') with amendment notes through Ley 20.446 (2025); many articles are restated amendments, and articles 6, 7, 9, 11, 23, 31, 39, 40 and 41 are repealed with no operative text. Articles 2 and 1-BIS both define free zones with slightly different wording, and art. 42 sets the same UI 10.000.000 maximum in paragraph 1 and letter A. Unnamed categories (usuarios, desarrolladores, organismos públicos) are not coded as entities. Decrees and Ley 20.446 art. 188 appear only as references; their content is not in this document.

evidence.quote: el Poder Ejecutivo establecerá requisitos en términos de niveles mínimos de personal ocupado o activos fijos

obligations.summary: The Executive Power shall adopt the necessary measures so that activities outside the free zone (new services to non-free territory) do not harm the competitiveness of firms already in non-free territory.

evidence.quote: El Poder Ejecutivo adoptará las medidas necesarias, a efectos de que estas actividades no perjudiquen la capacidad competitiva o exportadora de las empresas ya instaladas en zona no franca.

obligations.summary: The National Telecommunications Administration may not set differential telecommunications tariffs based on distance between Montevideo and the free zone; differences based on other grounds such as volume or traffic are allowed.

evidence.quote: La Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones no podrá fijar tarifas diferenciales para los servicios de telecomunicaciones fundadas en la distancia entre Montevideo y el lugar en que se encuentre emplazada la zona franca

obligations.summary: Only persons assigned to surveillance and maintenance of necessary services, and officials designated by the Executive Power, may reside within free zones.

evidence.quote: Solamente podrán habitar dentro de las zonas francas las personas destinadas a la vigilancia y al mantenimiento de los servicios necesarios

obligations.summary: Administration, supervision and control of free zones is assigned to the Ministry of Economy and Finance through the National Directorate of Free Zones.

evidence.quote: La administración, supervisión y control de las zonas francas estará a cargo del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas

obligations.summary: Developers shall collaborate with the Free Zones Area of the Directorate General of Commerce for compliance with the rules; the Executive Power may require developers to carry out specified activities.

evidence.quote: Los desarrolladores colaborarán con el Área Zonas Francas de la Dirección General de Comercio

obligations.summary: A private party applying for authorisation to operate a free zone must submit the application to the Executive Power with an investment project demonstrating economic viability and benefits to the country.

evidence.quote: La solicitud de autorización para explotación de zona franca por particulares deberá ser presentada al Poder Ejecutivo, acompañada de un proyecto de inversión

obligations.summary: Authorisation to operate a free zone by private parties is onerous: payment to the State of a lump sum or a periodic fee as agreed, without prejudice to Art. 30.

evidence.quote: La autorización será onerosa, ya sea mediante el pago al Estado de una suma única o mediante el pago de un canon períodico según se convenga

obligations.summary: Owners of land on which private free zones are installed must constitute an easement dedicating the property to that purpose, for a term equal to the operating authorisation.

evidence.quote: En los propietarios de los predios en que se instalen zonas francas privadas deberán constituir en ellos una servidumbre

obligations.summary: Legal persons becoming free-zone users must have as their exclusive purpose one of the activities provided for in the law, as regards their activity in national territory.

evidence.quote: Las personas jurídicas que se instalen en calidad de usuarios de zonas francas deberán tener como objeto exclusivo la realización de alguna de las actividades previstas en la presente ley

obligations.summary: Free-zone companies may not carry out industrial, commercial or service activities in the rest of national territory, except as provided in Art. 14 and Art. 53.

evidence.quote: las empresas instaladas en las zonas francas no podrán realizar actividades industriales, comerciales o de servicios en el resto del territorio nacional

obligations.summary: Users must obtain prior authorisation, under conditions set by the Executive Power, for auxiliary activities in national territory and for the exceptional activities listed in Art. 14.
obligations.conditional_on: auxiliary or exceptional activities outside free zones

evidence.quote: los usuarios deberán requerir la autorización previa en las condiciones que determine el Poder Ejecutivo

obligations.summary: Activities of users outside national territory, or relating to goods or services outside national territory, must be provided for in the contract and business plan approved by the Free Zones Area.

evidence.quote: debidamente aprobados por el Área Zonas Francas de la Dirección General de Comercio

obligations.summary: A user implementing telework must ensure at all times that the Developer can control the teleworking staff, with details of days and hours worked, which the National Directorate may request.

evidence.quote: deberá asegurar en todo momento al Desarrollador el control de los recursos humanos que teletrabajan

obligations.summary: Contracts by which users acquire user status must be registered with the National Directorate of Free Zones; once registered they are enforceable against third parties.

evidence.quote: Los contratos por los cuales se adquiere la calidad de usuario, deberán ser registrados en la Dirección de Zonas Francas

obligations.summary: Contracts regulating use rights in a free zone are deemed non-existent unless previously authorised by the Free Zones Area; applications must include information on the company and investment project.

evidence.quote: se tendrán por inexistentes si no hubieran sido autorizados previamente por el Área Zonas Francas de la Dirección General de Comercio

obligations.summary: Extension requests must be filed with the Free Zones Area at least 120 days before expiry of the original authorisation, and only after at least 85% of its term has elapsed, where the term allows.

evidence.quote: Las solicitudes de prórroga deberán presentarse ante el Área Zonas Francas de la Dirección General de Comercio con una antelación no menor a los ciento veinte días

obligations.summary: Direct and indirect users with contracts lacking a term, exceeding the statutory maximum, or with automatic extensions must present updated company and business plan documentation for approval within one year of the law's regulation.
obligations.applies_from: one year from the regulation of the law
obligations.conditional_on: contracts without a term or exceeding the Art. 16 maximum, or with automatic extensions

evidence.quote: deberán presentar dentro del término de un año desde la reglamentación de la ley, para su aprobación por el Área Zonas Francas

obligations.summary: Direct and indirect users must file a sworn declaration every two years with the Free Zones Area on compliance with the approved investment project.

evidence.quote: deberán presentar cada dos años una declaración jurada ante el Área Zonas Francas de la Dirección General de Comercio

obligations.summary: Founders of companies whose sole purpose is free-zone user activity may register directly only if at least 50% of share capital is subscribed by three or more persons and at least 60% of subscribed capital is paid in.
obligations.conditional_on: sociedades anónimas whose sole purpose is free-zone user activity

evidence.quote: se ha suscrito como mínimo el 50% (cincuenta por ciento) del capital social por tres o más personas físicas o jurídicas

obligations.summary: Users must employ at least 75% Uruguayan personnel (50% for service activities for the contract term) to keep their status and benefits; the Executive Power may reduce these percentages temporarily.
obligations.conditional_on: reduction may be authorised by the Executive Power

evidence.quote: emplearán en las actividades que realicen en las mismas un mínimo de 75 % (setenta y cinco por ciento) de personal constituido por ciudadanos uruguayos

obligations.summary: The State is liable for damages and shall ensure the user, during the contract, the tax exemptions, benefits and rights granted by the law.

evidence.quote: El Estado, bajo responsabilidad de daños y perjuicios, asegura al usuario, durante la vigencia de su contrato, las exoneraciones tributarias, beneficios y derechos

obligations.summary: Buildings constructed by the direct user may be used only for the user's activities; construction is governed by technical rules set by the Free Zones Directorate.

evidence.quote: Las mismas sólo podrán destinarse al cumplimiento de las actividades del usuario.

obligations.summary: Users must pay the operator's monetary charges for the whole period of occupation, including beyond the contract term and its extensions.

evidence.quote: deberán ser abonadas por el usuario por todo el tiempo que dure su ocupación

obligations.summary: Assignment of a direct user's contract requires the consent of the Free Zones Directorate (and of the co-contracting operator in private operations); contracts are non-existent unless previously approved by the Directorate.

evidence.quote: Dichos contratos se considerarán inexistentes si no hubiesen sido aprobados previamente por la Dirección de Zonas Francas.

obligations.summary: At the end of the contract term or extensions, direct or indirect users must vacate the free zone; otherwise the delivery procedure of the Civil Procedure Code applies.
obligations.conditional_on: end of contract term or extensions

evidence.quote: Finalizado el plazo contractual o sus prórrogas, el usuario directo o indirecto deberá desocupar la zona franca.

obligations.summary: Users may make improvements and constructions only with the written authorisation of the zone operator; unauthorised works benefit the operator without compensation.

evidence.quote: El usuario sólo podrá realizar mejoras y construcciones con la autorización escrita de quien explote la zona.

obligations.summary: Foreign goods destined for free zones must immediately fulfil that destination on arrival in the country and may not remain in any warehouse except customs premises, for the maximum period set by regulation.

evidence.quote: deberán cumplir de inmediato con dicho destino una vez llegados al país

obligations.summary: Retail trade within free zones is prohibited for direct and indirect users; provision of goods and services between users and developers, and services for zone staff, are excluded from the prohibition.

evidence.quote: No se permitirá el comercio al por menor dentro de las zonas francas en las actividades a realizar por los usuarios directos e indirectos.

obligations.summary: Private free-zone operators must keep adequate inventory control under the regime set by regulation.

evidence.quote: Los explotadores privados de zonas francas deberán llevar un adecuado control de inventarios, conforme al régimen que se establezca en la reglamentación.

obligations.summary: Private operators must carry out their operation under the terms of their authorisation; violation may incur a fine of up to UI 10,000,000 and revocation where appropriate.
obligations.conditional_on: private operators authorised to develop a free zone

evidence.quote: deberán realizar dicha operación en los términos que resulten de su autorización

obligations.summary: The Executive Power shall regulate the law and adopt measures to simplify export and import procedures for free-zone goods while keeping necessary controls.

evidence.quote: El Poder Ejecutivo reglamentará la presente ley y dispondrá las medidas necesarias

obligations.summary: Existing users of the Colonia and Nueva Palmira free zones are subject to the law; users operating simultaneously outside free zones have 180 days from the law's entry into force to comply with Art. 14.
obligations.applies_from: 180 days from the entry into force of this law
obligations.conditional_on: users operating simultaneously outside free zones

evidence.quote: dispondrán de un plazo de ciento ochenta días desde la vigencia de esta ley para adecuarse a lo previsto en el artículo 14

obligations.summary: The Executive Power shall ensure the preservation of the environment.

evidence.quote: El Poder Ejecutivo velará por la preservación del medio ambiente.

obligations.summary: Introduction into free zones of weapons, gunpowder, ammunition and other war materials, and items declared contrary to national interests by the Executive Power, is prohibited.

evidence.quote: Prohíbese la introducción a zonas francas de armas, pólvora, municiones y demás materias destinadas a usos bélicos

obligations.summary: Thematic service zones (audiovisual, leisure and entertainment, excluding gambling and betting) may be authorised only if located outside the Metropolitan Area.

evidence.quote: La explotación de zonas temáticas de servicios se podrá autorizar únicamente si las mismas se localizan fuera del Área Metropolitana

obligations.summary: Tax exemptions for IRAE and IVA on thematic-zone activities apply only to services provided to final consumers without tax residence in national territory, under conditions set by the Executive Power.
obligations.conditional_on: services to final consumers without tax residence in national territory

evidence.quote: se aplicarán exclusivamente con relación a los servicios prestados a consumidores finales que no tengan residencia fiscal en el territorio nacional

obligations.summary: Users of audiovisual thematic zones may carry out filming in the rest of national territory only under conditions set by the Executive Power and where the costs do not exceed 25% of the user's total annual costs.

evidence.quote: siempre que los costos de las mismas no excedan el 25% (veinticinco por ciento) de los costos totales anuales del usuario correspondiente

obligations.summary: The Executive Power shall allocate 100% of annual canon receipts from audiovisual thematic zones to national audiovisual content production lines of the Film and Audiovisual Promotion Fund.

evidence.quote: El Poder Ejecutivo destinará el 100% (cien por ciento) de lo percibido anualmente en concepto de canon de las zonas temáticas de servicios audiovisuales

enforcement.max_penalty_text: multa de hasta un máximo de UI 10.000.000 (diez millones de unidades indexadas)

evidence.quote: podrán ser objeto de una multa de hasta un máximo de UI 10.000.000 (diez millones de unidades indexadas)

enforcement.triggered_by: Violation or non-compliance by private companies authorized to develop a free zone, according to the nature of the violation or non-compliance

evidence.quote: sin perjuicio de la revocación de la autorización cuando correspondiere según la naturaleza de la violación o del incumplimiento

evidence.quote: Con multa de hasta un máximo de UI 10.000.000

enforcement.max_penalty_text: Con prohibición de ingresos y egresos de bienes o mercaderías o la realización de cualquier operación en calidad de usuario por un tiempo determinado
enforcement.penalty_formula: Graded under Código Tributario art. 100, per the final paragraph of Art. 42

enforcement.max_penalty_text: Con la pérdida de los beneficios que esta ley concede
enforcement.penalty_formula: Graded under Código Tributario art. 100, per the final paragraph of Art. 42

evidence.quote: Con la pérdida de los beneficios que esta ley concede
